spec.engine_series: wide monthly return minus ladder monthly return
spec.book_split: each book's own contrib sink is annualised per era SEPARATELY (wide and ladder), so the engine delta is rebuilt as wide_delta - ladder_delta instead of netting the two books before any attribution
spec.units: annualised bp of the era (mean monthly x 12 x 1e4)
spec.offset_disclosure: the decomposition level (sum of daily w*r) is published beside the compounded published level and their difference is quoted; only the DELTA is asserted to reconstruct

pre2017.drivers_note: the engine level is identical on both arms for this era, so there is no delta to split

2017_2020.drivers_note: the engine level is identical on both arms for this era, so there is no delta to split

honest: the split is arithmetic on the same w*r records E174 nets: a name held by both books appears in both lists and neither list alone reconstructs the engine delta

the ladder leg is a fixed five-name book, so a ladder-side delta is the repair re-pricing those five members, not the wide book's selection changing; whether any of them was neutralised is derived from the screen report and published beside the zeros
the DELTA is what reproduces here; the LEVELS sit apart by the compounding offset quoted per era and are not used for any verdict
an era whose engine level did not move is the built-in control: a book that moved there would mean the split is reading noise
